summary: This React component renders a link to a Bluesky post. It pulls the user's Bluesky handle from the site configuration and the post identifier from the page metadata, then builds a URL and displays it as a clickable button with an icon and text. If either the handle or post ID is missing, it renders nothing instead.

explanations.13: We're asking Docusaurus for the site's configuration object, then drilling down into customFields.bluesky and telling TypeScript this value might be undefined.
explanations.15: We're safely extracting the Bluesky post ID from nested properties (metadata → frontMatter → blueskyRecordKey), which might not exist.
explanations.17: We bail out early and return null (rendering nothing) if we're missing either the Bluesky handle from config or the post key from metadata, so we can't build a valid link.
explanations.29: The translate function wraps a string to make it available for translation/internationalization — the 'id' acts as a key, and 'message' is the English fallback text shown to users.
